content: Standard pattern: role (supervisor/vendedor) stored in a profiles table referencing auth.users; RLS policies on clientes/cards check auth.uid() and caller role, filtering rows by responsavel = auth.uid() for vendedores, allowing all rows for supervisores. Next.js middleware using supabase ssr refreshes the session and does coarse route protection, but authoritative access control lives in RLS policies, not middleware or client code.
